summary: Tested the new Ticketing/Support System feature. All 17 backend API tests pass. Frontend UI verified: Help button visible in main site context, ticket creation dialog with pre-filled info, priority selector, user journey preview, ticket list page with filters, ticket detail page with conversation thread and visual journey timeline, admin status change, and reply functionality.

backend_api_tests.POST /api/tickets/ (create): PASS - Ticket created with all fields
backend_api_tests.GET /api/tickets/{id}: PASS - Returns ticket with messages and user_journey

frontend_tests.Help button visibility: PASS - data-testid='help-button' visible in main site context (bottom-left)
frontend_tests.Pre-filled info: PASS - Name, Page, Site, Browser fields shown
frontend_tests.Priority buttons: PASS - All 4 priorities (low, normal, high, urgent) with data-testid
frontend_tests.Ticket submission: PASS - Dialog closes, ticket created via POST /api/tickets/
frontend_tests.Status filters: PASS - data-testid='ticket-filters' with all status options
frontend_tests.Ticket meta info: PASS - data-testid='ticket-meta' shows Page, URL, Browser, IP, Site
frontend_tests.Reply submission: PASS - Message appears with Admin badge
frontend_tests.Status change: PASS - Toast shows 'Status changed to in_progress'

critical_code_review_comments: HelpButton.js uses MainSiteContext so it only shows in main site routes - this is intentional
Support Tickets navigation is in a collapsible 'Support' group in the sidebar
Visual journey timeline shows color progression (green->blue->amber->red) with the error page highlighted
Admin badge shown on replies from admins/network admins
bug_fixes_applied: Fixed missing trailing slash in HelpButton.js API call (/api/tickets -> /api/tickets/)
Fixed missing trailing slash in TicketsPage.js API calls
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test tickets during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ticketing system fully tested and working. Help button appears in bottom-left corner when in main site context (e.g., /radiogroep/shows). Ticket creation dialog includes pre-filled user info, priority selector, and user journey preview. Tickets list at /:mainSiteSlug/tickets with status filters. Ticket detail shows conversation thread with admin badges and visual user journey timeline. Admin can change ticket status with toast confirmation. NOTE: 2FA modal may appear after login/navigation - dismiss with 'Skip for now' button.
